model.name: R19.98: Identical files must render in ALL rooms — no per-room stale-cache inversion.
model.description: BUG (v0.5.228): identical files in the SYSTEM TEST room do NOT render for Tron, while the md-safari room with the same files DOES render them. This is an inversion — the same data renders in one room but not another. Likely per-room stale cache or per-room scenario-unit load inconsistency. FIX: file rendering must be deterministic per FileUnit UUID regardless of which room displays it. If the FileUnit exists in the index and is in Room.files[], it renders. No per-room cache should suppress rendering.
model.tronQuote: > PO relay (Tron v0.5.228): identical files in SYSTEM TEST room don't render while md-safari DOES — inversion, likely per-room stale cache.
model.crossRefNote: R19.46 (Room.files[] as source of truth) and R19.92 (same data path as /trace) — if both are correct, file rendering should be room-agnostic. R19.98 identifies a per-room inconsistency that violates this.
